summary: Iteration 166 - Laundry Items CRUD + Smart Order Forecast Testing. Backend: 27/27 tests passed. Frontend: Laundry Settings Panel with 3 tabs verified (Providers, Contracts, Items). Items tab shows 11 rows with correct columns. Laundry Management forecast tab navigation had sidebar issues but backend APIs fully functional.
seed_data_creation: 11 default laundry items seeded on first API call
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend APIs for laundry items CRUD and forecast are fully functional. Frontend Laundry Settings Panel verified with 3 tabs. Laundry Management forecast tab exists but sidebar navigation to Operations > Laundry can be tricky - need to scroll and expand Operations section first.

laundry_items_crud.GET /api/laundry/items/{property_id}: Returns 11 seeded items with all required fields (washing_cost, purchase_cost, maintenance_cost, per_cleaning_qty, sort_order, active, usage_30d, total_cost)
laundry_items_crud.POST /api/laundry/items/{property_id}: Creates new item, validates duplicate names (400), validates empty name (400)
laundry_items_crud.PUT /api/laundry/items/{item_id}: Updates item fields, coerces strings to float/int, toggles active status, returns 404 for invalid ID

forecast.GET /api/laundry/forecast/{property_id}: Returns forecast with delivery_date, horizon_days, in_house_cleaning_every, bookings_in_window, total_cleaning_events, daily breakdown, items with shortfall, summary. Items with per_cleaning_qty=0 (Table Cloth, Napkin) excluded.
forecast.POST /api/laundry/forecast/{property_id}: Creates dispatch with from_forecast:true, status:sent, correct total_cost. Validates vendor required (400). Recomputes if no items provided.

laundry_settings_panel.3_tabs: Laundry Providers, Laundry Contracts, Laundry Items
laundry_settings_panel.items_tab: Shows 11 rows with columns: Item, Washing Cost, Purchase Cost, Maintenance, Per Cleaning, Used (30d), Status, Actions
